- Initial release of Hug Video Maker Free.
- Quickly create animated hug videos from your photos or clips—no video editing experience needed.
- Upload images or clips (JPG, PNG, MP4, MOV, up to 200MB) and generate a 1080p MP4 hug animation for easy sharing.
- Fully cloud-based workflow with automatic account setup, session management, and credit handling (100 free credits, 7-day expiry for new users).
- Simple commands let you upload, edit, preview, check credits, and export videos with natural language.
- Optimized for fast creation and sharing of heartfelt hug videos on social media.
